messages.content: You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

“Judah gam lhanglama chengten Edom gamsung alo diu ahi. Lhumlam thinglhang bul’a chengten Philistia gam alah diu ahi. Israelten Ephraim le Samaria alah diu, Benjamin chaten Gilead alah diu ahi.
Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
Chrita Jesu Jal’a sohchang Paul le sopi Timothyn, ingailut tah-u le itoh khompiu Philemon,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
Thuhil kicheh mangchaa tilkhouna abol theiya chule adouho nelkelna chu alekhup theina dinga kihilna dunguiya ginchat umtah thu chu tuhchah mi hiding ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Soh ho chu ijakaiya apakaiteu thu noiya nungjel thei, nelkel louhel’a lung lhaisahjo hiuhen.
Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
Aman hongphal tah in Yeshua Christa vang'in ichunguvah Lhagao theng chu abunglhan ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
Chutobangma chun, nupi tehse lang jep ho jong chu Pathen jatah'a hinkho mang din hil'in. Amaho chu mihehse hatle ju a lop hilouva, chusanga midang thilpha ipi ahi ahildiu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.
“Judah gam lhanglama chengten Edom gamsung alo diu ahi. Lhumlam thinglhang bul’a chengten Philistia gam alah diu ahi. Israelten Ephraim le Samaria alah diu, Benjamin chaten Gilead alah diu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.
Vo Nineveh, nakhosunga hi thilse jeng bol mi, Pakai dou khat hun gpeng doh ding ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

Eihojong, khatvei chu, lungthimbei le seingailou inahiu ahi. Eiho lamdihlou lama puilonlea inaum uva chule tahsa lungngaichat le nomsahna tamtah soh a inaum'u ahi. Ihinkhou chu gitlouna le kithangsetto naa dima, chule khatle khat kihotoa ina umu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
Koi hijongleh hiche thuhila kona vahmang ho chu Pathen to kijopmat lou ahiuve. Hinlah koi hijongleh Christa thuhila umjing ho chu Pa le Chapa to kigui jop jingna nei ahitai.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Thua nung lou atam lheh jengun thu motsei seiya milhen chavai adim’ui, amaho chu cheptan ho lah a atamdeh-ui.
For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
kikop khom cheh tahsan dungjuiya chatah tah Titus henga: Pa Pathen le eihuhhingpau Christa Jesua konin lungsetna le chamna nachunga um hen.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Koima taitom louhel le koima kinahpi lou, chon nem’a, mijouse chunga nun nem dingin jong hilphan.
to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
chule isopinu'u Apphia chule kasepai chankhompiu Archippus, chule na-in'a kikhom houbung henga dinga kahinsut ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Hitobang miho chun akamsunguva Pathen kahenai tin aphongdoh nauvin, ahinlah ahinkho mandan uvin aseilep un ahi. Amaho chu thet umtah, thungailou ahiuvin, thilpha bolna lama panna bei ahiuve.
They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

Na sopi soh changa kikaimang lai a, nangman amaho hamsetna chu, kipana nalah lou ding ahi. Kamiten gim hesoh athohpet’a, nangman a hamsetnau chu nakipapi lou ding ahi. Chuleh hiche hesoh genthei nikho’a chu, kiletsah ham-hoitho na bollou ding ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
Ima guh a kiseldoh louvin ijakaiya tahsan thei mong ahi nau thilpha chu vetsahjo’u hen; chutile imalam jousea eihuhhinguva Pathen thuhil chu ajep hoi thei diu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Sakeichal’in sa athat jin, Sakeipi le anoute ahal hal’in aoppeh-in, akosung chu athasa Agu aphe adimset’in ahi.
The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

hiche Lhagao Theng chu eihuhhingpau jesu Christa jal’a ichunguva leiset’a abuh lhah ahitai.
whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Ajeh chu Pakai Yeshuan atahsan le Pathen mite jouse nangailut thudol kana jajingin ahi.
hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Hiche hettohsah hi a dih monge. Hijeh chun amaho tahsan kicheh mi ahina diuvin hatah-in phohsal’in.
This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Hichea kisun cheng hi, Elkosh khoa mi Nahumin Nineveh khopi thudol’a themgao thilmua amu thu kisun ahi.
A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
“Nasopite, Jacob chilhah ho nachomgama natha jal’a, nakisugam hel ding, a-itih a jum thoh a na um ding ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
Hiche lekhathot hi upa John a kon ahi. Keiman thutah'a kangailut, lhendoh numei Ja-umnu le achate chule keima jengseh hilouva, thutah heho jouse hetdia jong kajih ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
Thua nung lou atam lheh jengun thu motsei seiya milhen chavai adim’ui, amaho chu cheptan ho lah a atamdeh-ui.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
Katao chanin phat jousen nangma kageldoh jingin ka-Pathen kathang vah jinge;
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

“Zion molsanga phabep hung jamlut’un tin, alhang jeng jong muntheng soh ding ahi. Jacob chaten agoulo gamu chu alo kit diu ahitai.
But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

Chule asepai gal-hat ho chu alumu asan soh keijin, A sepaiten abonchauvin pon san-ao akisil sohkeijun. Kangtalai jouse jong meisi bang in apah lah lah-in, Galsat dia akigoltoh tenguleh akipat kal’u angah lel’ui.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

namudoh chan nungjam a, Nineveh khopi khogem asoh tai! Voujang natpia koi ham? Alhem lung mong nom koi ham?’ tia asei diu ahi,” ati.
It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Chule eihon Christa a ineiyu thilpha jouse hetna le hetchetna hin nanga um natahsan chu thilpha boldohna asona dingin kataopeh jinge.
that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Vo Assyria kumpipa, nagam vaipote athisoh tai, namilen milalte jong akijamddap soh tauve. Namite molle lhanga akithe thangsoh-un, in a puilut jou koima aumtapoi.
Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

Keiman nangho koma thutampi seibe ding kanei nalaiye, hinlah keiman lekhapeh le lekha-twiyin kajih nompoi. Ajeh chu keiman nangho hung muloi ding kakinepna ahi. Chule kimaitoa nangho to kihoulim ding kanom'e. Chutengleh ikinepnau chamkim tante.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
Jacob chate le Joseph chate chu meikou bang jeng diu, meiyin changpol akah banga Esau chate asuhgam diu ahi. Esau chilhah khatcha hingdoh ponte, Kei-Pakaiyin kasei ahitai.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Lengnu soh-in akai tauvin, Alhachate vahui maovin amaovui. Chule dip le lai kidop’in aumtauve.
It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

chusanga jindot them, thilpha dei, lung limgeh, midih, hougut mi, kitim them mi hiding ahi.
but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Ajeh chu chutobang miho chu lamvaija chule chonsejia ahiuvin, amaho le amaho achonset nauvin themmo achan ahi.
knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

katoh khompi cheng Mark, Aristarchus, Demas chule Luke hite hon jong nasalam’ui.
as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
Thil kibol bulhing lou chengse naboltup soh a chule khopi jousea upa ho napansah na dinga Crete a kadalhah nahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
Pakaiyin amite Israel jeh a asei chu hiche hi ahi: “Assyria mite hi hat hen lang tam jong leu, kisugam a amngthah diu ahi. Vo kamite, hesoh genthei kathohsah nahiuvin, avel’in bol kit taponge.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
Dangka sana kichoi’uvin! Khopi sunga gou dimset’in akikhol’e.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
Upa keiman lhentum Numei lalnu chule achate changse, thutah a ka-ngailut, kei chang hilouva, thutah heho jousen jong angailut ho heng,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Ijeh-inem itile ama kamphaa houva chun ama toh gitlou jouse jong achankhompi ahitai.
for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
Pakai angsunga molle lhang jouse killing jeng, Lhang sang jouse amasanga jolsoh jeng ahi. Pakai hung kilah teng leiset kithinga, Leiset le amite kithing jeng ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Kho ki-umna dingin twi gathal loijin, na kulpi jouse kikaidet loijin; bonlhoh lah a lenglut jeng in chule changpol chilgoijin, cheh deng loijin;
Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
eiho sunga um jing, tonsot geiya eiumpi jing diu thutah jal’in:
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Nangman phat chomkhat a dinga Onesimus hi namansah chu aitih a naumpiden theina ding hinte.
For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
Nachate konkhatse Paa kona ikisan’u thupeh dungjuiya chon kamun, kakipah lheh jengin ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
ama dei phat cha athu hung kiphongdoh a, eihuhhingpau Pathen thupeh dungjuiya keima eiki-nganse chu:
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Pakai hi anun nemin, Gim hesoh nikhon amite ahoidamin; Aheng jon chan avetup theiye.
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Jerusalema galjouten Edom delkhumintin achunga vaihom diu, Pakai amatah leng chang ding ahi,” ati.
Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be the LORD’s.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says the LORD.
“Amavang, muvanlai bangin nang masang tahin leng sang inlang, ahsi holah'a chenna ding buhsa jongle chun, chukoma kon a chu keiman nangma kaloi lhah ding ahi,” tin Pakai in a seiye.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
Amaho lah jenga jong, mi khat, Crete a kona themgao khat, in amaho thudol hitin aseiyin, “Crete miho hi abon'uva mijou, gam sahang, chule mithase nehlop ahiuve” ati.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

nasepaite jong asildap soh tan, namelmate masanga pang jou ding abeitai. Nakelkot gol jouse meiyin akahvam ding ahi.
Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Pakai douna dinga tohgon neija, hangsan tah’a thuseija pang, nangmaa kon mihem khatbe hung louham?
One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Hiche thu hi tahsan umtah ahin, nangman hiti thudol’a hin Pathen tahsante chu thilpha bolna lam jenga dettah a dindet theina diuva lung nagelsah ding kadeiye. Hiche ho hi mihemte dinga pha, thil phachomtah ahi.

This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.
Judah gama nasopite hamset chu nakipapi lou ding dol ahi. Ahamset nikhouva chu nakipa lou ding, agim nau chu nuisat hoh a nanei lou ding ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Nineveh khopi asumangun, min adalhan, akeovin akijamtai! Mihem lung kichat’in anemsoh tan; Thabeiyin khupbuh kithing thingin, Mihem mai adangsoh tai!
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

“If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

Gucha ho chu, jan teng hung’u hen lang na chom gam’u jong leh, amahon na nei na gou jouse ladoh chai deh pouvinte. Lengpi ga loukhoma pang hon jong, mivaicha gentheite dinga dalhah anei mong’u ahi. Ahinlah, namel maten vang nang leh na nei jouse abon’a phet gamhel diu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
Hicheng se hi nasei ding, thu neina lhingset’a natilkhouva nahilchah ding ahin, koima chan nahsah mon nabolda hen.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Kamiten talen ju kha tah adontauve, ka lhang theng chunga chun, ahinla akimvel’a cheng namtin vaipin akhacheh talen ju adon diu ahi. Ju donchimset’untin leng mang jel diu ahi.
For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Tahsan chate chu solkal le avaipoho thunoiya umdingin geldohsah in. Amaho chu seingai, thilpha boldia phat jousea kigosadema umjing hidiu ahi.
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
Titus, nangman vang, kithuhilna dihtah dungjuiya hinkho manding dan domsang in.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
Chutima chun Mark, Aristarchus, Demas chule katohkhompi Luke teho hin nangho lemnathu aseiyuve.
